title: 序章13 决心的萌芽序章14 准备与意外
content_zh:
第二天清晨，黎木早早便起来锻炼。
不是他有多勤快，而是夜晚实在太冷了，根本睡不好。
原本他以为监狱的环境已经足够恶劣了，没想到这矿坑更加黑暗。
马尔提雅奴隶高度商品化。
按道理来说，像工头这种罪犯随意杀死奴隶，是损坏财产，应当“罪加一等”
但“劣精”
实在是太便宜了，就算不小心弄死了，也顶多“延长服刑期”
可马尔提雅的历史底蕴太浅薄了，有关法律方面漏洞百出。
对于服刑期本就超长的工头来说，杀再多劣精，也没有影响，反正这辈子离不开矿坑了，倒不如彻底放飞自我，多弄死些劣精来报复贵族。
只要不搞“大屠杀”
做的太明显，影响到矿坑开采效率，平常偶尔弄死几个劣精根本没人管。
“呼~”
黎木长出一口气，缓缓收回了拳脚。
腹中空空，不宜锻炼太多，还是留着些体力的好。
盘膝而坐，黎木闭上了双眼，开始调整呼吸和内里。
越是在这种环境恶劣的地方，越要注重锻炼。
增强体质，调节情绪。
否则早晚有一天自己也会成为那群劣精中的一员。
心慢慢静了下来，可环境却没有。
“窸窸窣窣~”

不远处有劣精偷偷啃食同类尸体的声响，也有劣精偷偷杀死同类的动静。
强忍着心中的不适，黎木就这样一直熬到了天明，跟着所有劣精一起，再次拿起了镐子凿矿。
不同于昨天的是。
工头身边，今天站着一位贵族。
“喂！
新来的劣种们，来领一下你们的衣服。”
工头似乎也收敛了一点。
很快，新来的劣精们排成一排，前往那名贵族旁的箱子里领取一件“草裙”
“......”
虽然黎木不想表现的惹眼，但还是因为相貌太特殊而被那名贵族注意到了。
黎木来到这领取队伍中时，他能够明显的感受到，那名贵族对自己的窥觑之意。
回到矿坑里侧。
“木，你们也领到草裙了吗？现在，你也一样了啊...”
content_en:
The next morning, Li Mu got up early to exercise.
It's not that he's very diligent, but it's just that it's too cold at night and he can't sleep well at all.
He originally thought that the prison environment was bad enough, but he didn't expect that the mine would be even darker.
Marthian slaves were highly commodified.
Logically speaking, if a criminal like a foreman kills slaves at will, he damages property and should be punished with an additional penalty.
But "evil"
It’s really too cheap. Even if he accidentally kills him, the most he can do is “extend his sentence.”
But Martiya's historical background is too shallow, and the relevant laws are full of loopholes.
For the foreman who served a long sentence, it would not matter no matter how many scoundrels he killed. Anyway, he could not do without the mines in his life, so it was better to let himself go completely and kill more scoundrels to take revenge on the nobles.
As long as there is no "massacre"
It was too obvious and affected the mining efficiency of the mine. Normally, a few bad guys would be killed occasionally and no one would care.
"Huh~"
Li Mu let out a long breath and slowly retracted his fists and feet.
If your stomach is empty, you shouldn't exercise too much. It's better to save some energy.
Sitting cross-legged, Li Mu closed his eyes and began to adjust his breathing and inner feelings.
The more harsh the environment is in such a place, the more attention should be paid to exercise.
Enhance physical fitness and regulate emotions.
Otherwise, sooner or later, one day I will become one of those bad guys.
My heart slowly calmed down, but the environment did not.
"Rustling, rustling~"
Not far away, there was the sound of evil spirits secretly eating the corpses of the same kind, and there was also the sound of evil spirits secretly killing the same kind.
Suppressing the discomfort in his heart, Li Mu stayed up until dawn, and together with all the bad guys, he picked up the pickaxe to dig into the mine again.
It's different from yesterday.
Next to the foreman, today stood a noble.
"Hey!
New bad guys, come and get your clothes. "
The foreman seemed to have calmed down a bit.
Soon, the new bad guys lined up and went to the box next to the noble to receive a "grass skirt"
"..."
Although Li Mu didn't want to stand out, he was noticed by the noble because of his special appearance.
When Li Mu came to the collection team, he could clearly feel that the noble was looking at him.
Return to the inside of the mine.
"Mu, did you get a grass skirt too? Now, you are the same..."
